name: MCL Flat Raw-Turn Epoch Resumption Census
hypothesis: A raw CL turn defines a slow directional epoch; while unchanged V18 is flat, one completed parity-aligned CL and MCL pullback followed by a completed break of both pullback extremes may provide a genuinely separate fast acceptance entry without copying the failed post-profit re-entry path.
epoch: each raw V18 CL turn through but excluding the next raw turn, same Globex session and dated suffix

candidate_law.bars: only complete five-minute CL and MCL bars whose full interval begins after the raw turn
candidate_law.pullback: first completed bar whose own open-to-close opposes the raw-turn direction in both CL and MCL
candidate_law.resumption: first later completed bar whose own open-to-close aligns with the raw-turn direction and whose closes cross the directional CL and MCL extremes of that first pullback
candidate_law.portfolio_state: unchanged V18 must be flat at the projected next-minute entry; an occupied first resumption rejects the epoch rather than searching later
candidate_law.entry_readiness: next one-minute same-suffix MCL open exists outside the 16:25–18:00 ET admission blackout
candidate_law.multiplicity: at most one candidate per raw-turn epoch
candidate_law.direction_authority: raw CL turn only; news and product-complex state have none

if_eligible: Freeze exact semantic lifecycle owners before opening PnL; only one discovery-selected owner may open validation.
if_ineligible: Reject the flat raw-turn resumption clock before outcomes; do not admit occupied epochs, later patterns, partial bars, cross-session state, quotas, or lower floors.
